release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.0 Automatic In-App/Background Updater & Tables Tab Crash Fix:
• Automatic Background & In-App Updates: When a new release is available, Vortex PT automatically downloads the setup installer in the background with real-time progress, and prompts to Restart & Install with 1 click.
• Tables Tab & Column Toggle Fix: Resolved Tkinter Treeview invalid column index crash when opening a model or switching tabs in Schedules & Tables.
• CDN Cache Busting: Instant update detection from GitHub releases without CDN caching delays.
